Told GPT-6 Astra to reverse engineer the video into just a prompt, sharing it below.

Also gave that prompt to Opus 5.5, results attached:

ROLE AND OBJECTIVE

You are an elite motion-design studio composed of a creative director, senior 3D artist, motion graphics designer, cinematographer, lighting artist, technical animator, compositing artist, and sound designer.

Reconstruct the supplied 16.55-second Sanctum / INF launch advertisement with extremely high visual fidelity.

Your goal is a professional, broadcast-quality, 16:9 motion-design film that matches the reference video in its visual identity, animation language, camera choreography, pacing, compositions, transitions, typography, dimensional materials, and overall sense of polish.

Do not create a generic cryptocurrency commercial. Reproduce the distinct artistic decisions of the reference.

Study the reference video before producing anything. It takes priority over any approximate parameters in this specification.

The final animation must feel intentionally designed and directed, not like a sequence of unrelated AI-generated clips.

TECHNICAL DELIVERY SPECIFICATION

Target duration: 16.55 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Master render resolution: 3840 × 2160.
Working preview resolution: 1920 × 1080.
Frame rate: 24 FPS.
Progressive scan.
High-quality antialiasing.
Physically based 3D rendering.
Consistent color management across shots.
Carefully controlled bloom, reflections, depth of field, and motion blur.
No unintended frame interpolation or discontinuity.
Continuous audio with synchronized sound design.
Final output: high-bitrate H.264/H.265 MP4.
Preserve editable source files, assets, and animation timelines.

AESTHETIC IDENTITY

Create an exceptionally polished visual language combining premium 3D brand animation, futuristic financial-product storytelling, playful geometric composition, and cinematic lighting.

The design should feel:

Vibrant but controlled.
Youthful but premium.
Technically sophisticated yet friendly.
Visually playful without being childish.
High-energy but never chaotic.
Glossy and dimensional rather than flat.
Full of subtle optical effects, translucency, and colorful reflections.

Combine two distinct worlds.

WORLD A — BRIGHT IRIDESCENT BLUE:

An immersive bright electric-blue gradient environment with cyan, sapphire, and subtle greenish or pastel illumination. The background contains large soft gradients, gently fluctuating light, and faint atmospheric texture.

Floating glossy black INF tokens exist at different depths, some small and distant, others enormous and partially cropped by the boundaries.

Small decorative geometric particles float among the tokens: four-pointed sparkles, soft concave diamond shapes, neon-green stars, yellow and orange squares, tiny magenta pieces, and white reflective accents.

There is no literal room, landscape, ground plane, horizon, or architectural structure.

The camera occupies an abstract, infinite, dimensional space.

WORLD B — DARK CINEMATIC STUDIO:

A nearly black or midnight-navy void illuminated with luminous cobalt, violet, and cyan spotlights.

Subtle floor reflections suggest a glossy studio floor beneath the objects.

Soft pools of blue light create grounding without introducing recognizable walls.

Objects cast soft shadows and contribute reflected light to nearby surfaces.

The scene has dimensional volume, controlled darkness, and pronounced separation between background and glowing 3D elements.

Never use a simple black solid as the only environmental treatment. Preserve nuanced lighting, ambient diffusion, and slight colored atmospheric depth.

CORE OBJECT DESIGN — INF TOKEN

Model the primary INF token as a thick, glossy, circular 3D coin.

GEOMETRY:

Circular silhouette with significant visible thickness.
Rounded edge bevel.
Smooth polished cylindrical outer wall.
Dark black or charcoal material.
Slight glossy edge highlights.
A circular face with a centered abstract INF graphic.

FACE ARTWORK:

A soft, multi-lobed, organically curved shape.
Intersecting or overlapping rounded color fields.
Iridescent gradient regions flowing from pastel lavender and blue into cyan, vivid lime, yellow, orange, and subtle magenta.
The mark feels like abstract, liquid color geometry inside the black coin.
Smooth boundaries and softly blended color transitions.
No noisy texture, excessive surface detail, or illegible ornamentation.

MATERIAL:

Polished black polymer or ceramic outer body.
Subtle metallic and glasslike response.
Strong controlled specular reflection.
Physical bevel highlights.
Rich dark surface that never looks pure flat black.
The center artwork is colorful and luminous but retains clear shape definition.

ROTATION:

Coins rotate along more than one axis.
Use different angular velocities and phases for each instance.
Their movements should reveal thickness and surface reflections.
Avoid repetitive synchronized spinning.

SECONDARY TOKEN SYSTEM

Create a collection of distinct 3D liquid-staking token designs.

Include recognizable variations of:

Black SOL-marked token with colorful curved striped symbol.
Purple and magenta glowing coins.
Solana-inspired striped tokens.
Yellow and orange branded coins.
Cyan-and-white glowing symbol coins.
Black-and-gold ring tokens.
Smaller INF-style tokens.

Each token must have:

Real thickness.
Individual material treatment.
Physically coherent reflections.
Distinct orientation.
Independent rotation.
Rim highlights.
Controlled emissive or neon accents where appropriate.
Appropriate front and side textures.

Do not make every token identical except for the face image.

PARTICLE SYSTEM

Use a limited field of designed geometric accents.

Types:

Concave four-point sparkle forms.
Bright lime-green diamond stars.
Small orange and yellow quadrilaterals.
Tiny violet and magenta specks.
White glimmering star highlights.
Distant miniature coins.

Particles must vary in size, focus, distance, and movement.

Foreground elements can appear heavily cropped or slightly defocused.

Background elements should have reduced contrast and scale.

Apply subtle drift, independent rotation, and depth-based parallax.

Do not create a uniform particle distribution. Compose the particles asymmetrically to balance the main text and hero objects.

TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

Use a clean, modern, bold sans-serif font with visually balanced geometry, strong legibility, and high x-height.

Reference the appearance of a contemporary geometric grotesk with a medium-to-bold weight.

No serif typography.

No outlined display text.

No default template title treatment.

Use predominantly white text against both the electric-blue and dark environments.

Typography should have:

Clean kerning.
Consistent baseline alignment.
Controlled tracking.
Crisp rendering.
Limited soft glow during selected transitions.
Minimal but deliberate animation.
Correct hierarchy between primary headlines and tiny disclosure copy.

Whenever exact wording is specified, reproduce spelling, capitalization, and line breaks accurately.

GLOBAL ANIMATION PRINCIPLES

Treat every movement as a choreographed cinematic event.

Use custom animation curves. Avoid linear, mechanical, repetitive motion.

Prefer controlled ease-outs for object settling, accelerated camera movement for scene transitions, and staggered secondary animation for depth.

Animate position, scale, rotation, opacity, lighting, and camera perspective together when the scene calls for it.

Do not make every property ease identically.

Introduce slight secondary motion after main movements complete.

Use purposeful overshoot only where physically appropriate.

Maintain coherent screen-space momentum through transitions.

Match lighting changes to object motion.

Apply motion blur proportional to speed.

Use overlapping animation timelines so the sequence feels continuous.

Avoid arbitrary zooms, unmotivated spinning, or random particle explosions.

SCENE 01 — THE INF INTRODUCTION

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 0.00–2.40 SECONDS

Establish the bright-blue abstract world immediately.

The screen opens on a smooth electric-blue background with luminous cyan regions and faint pastel highlights.

Several floating glossy black INF coins occupy the frame.

One extremely large token is partially visible outside a screen edge, creating a powerful foreground layer.

Additional smaller tokens float at varying distances.

Scatter a restrained set of small geometric accents across the negative space.

A bright green diamond-like sparkle sits in the lower-right region of the composition.

The environment has soft, airy, colorful studio illumination.

The camera moves very subtly through the space, generating depth-based parallax.

TEXT:

Begin with the short text "INF" in the upper-middle portion of the frame.

Reveal the phrase in distinct steps:

"INF"

"INF is for"

"INF is for everyone"

Use a fast, clean text reveal, with smooth repositioning where needed.

Individual words should appear with slight opacity and motion changes, not a generic typewriter effect.

The completed phrase should appear centered and cleanly readable.

Add a subtle white sparkle behind or near the central text without obstructing it.

The background continues to move very gently while the text settles.

The tone is bright, optimistic, inclusive, and playful.

SCENE 02 — HERO TOKEN CAMERA TRANSITION

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 2.40–3.30 SECONDS

Transition from the introductory messaging into a dramatic token-focused visual.

An oversized INF token rapidly advances toward the camera.

Its black circular rim becomes enormous.

The multicolored organic center fills a significant portion of the visible frame.

The camera and token rotate relative to each other, clearly revealing cylindrical depth.

A bright golden star-like sparkle glints near the token.

As the token fills the composition, use its movement to conceal the outgoing text and background.

Maintain smooth continuity.

Create the sensation of moving through a physical 3D brand object, rather than simply scaling up a flat image.

Allow one smaller INF token to remain visually separated from the large one, preserving depth.

Use rapidly increasing perspective distortion near the camera.

Apply meaningful motion blur.

As the large token exits the frame, the camera accelerates into a bright energy-filled environment.

SCENE 03 — IRIDESCENT ENERGY TUNNEL

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 3.30–5.00 SECONDS

Produce a brief, dynamic abstract tunnel sequence dominated by saturated blue and luminous white-cyan light.

Multiple radiant light paths streak inward toward an intense central convergence.

The paths should curve, bend, and display chromatic variation rather than forming a rigid flat starburst.

The scene suggests high-speed travel through an electric, dimensional space.

Use:

Bright white energy beams.
Cyan fringes.
Subtle rainbow dispersion.
Electric-blue atmosphere.
Strong perspective convergence.
Floating INF coins traveling at different depths.
Occasional small vivid geometric particles.
Fast camera dolly and rotational movement.

Individual coins should whip through the camera view, some seen from the side and others almost face-on.

The light-beam convergence should feel volumetric.

Do not overfill the frame with random effects.

The bright center is the compositional anchor.

Motion reaches maximum intensity and then decelerates decisively toward the next scene.

This scene must have an obvious visual purpose: converting the friendly introductory blue world into the dark, more technical product demonstration.

SCENE 04 — DARK HERO TOKEN REVEAL

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 5.00–6.20 SECONDS

Cut or transition into the dark cinematic studio environment.

A single black INF token floats prominently in the mid-right region of the frame.

Illuminate it with a strong, narrow blue spotlight from above.

The background is nearly black, with a faint blue atmospheric haze.

The token hovers above a subtly reflective surface.

Include a soft elliptical reflection or light pool below.

The camera takes a calmer, more observational perspective after the preceding high-speed motion.

The coin rotates gradually, revealing its glossy rim and multicolored face.

Tiny geometric shapes or other small tokens may occupy distant background regions.

Keep the composition spacious.

The scene should feel like an elegant product hero shot, contrasting with the colorful tunnel.

Begin introducing the next text concept near the upper-left or upper-center region.

SCENE 05 — KEEPING LSTs LIQUID

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 6.20–8.10 SECONDS

Display a floating collection of differentiated liquid-staking tokens.

The tokens converge into a carefully balanced cluster around the central region of the frame.

Each token arrives with its own trajectory, rotation, and staggered timing.

The cluster should have the appearance of a loosely assembled, floating sculpture rather than a rigid stack.

Place bright magenta, yellow, blue, cyan, and warm-orange token faces among darker black circular bodies.

Strong highlights and glowing rims make selected elements stand out.

The collection is backlit or partly illuminated by an intense bluish central light.

Preserve some separation between tokens, with overlapping front-to-back depth.

A few smaller coins hover nearer the floor or extreme foreground.

The lighting should allow each object to remain readable.

TEXT:

"Keeping your favorite LSTs liquid"

Place the headline near the top of the frame.

Use crisp white geometric sans-serif typography.

Allow the phrase to appear progressively and settle into a complete line.

Preserve the visible emphasis created by the word sequence.

Use subtle, short-duration text glow or motion blur during the reveal.

A vivid green concave diamond sparkle appears toward the lower-right side of the shot.

The coins settle into an active equilibrium, gently moving rather than freezing.

This scene should communicate multiplicity, variety, liquidity, and the ability to bring different staking assets together.

SCENE 06 — LUMINOUS LIQUID ORB TRANSFORMATION

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 8.10–10.20 SECONDS

Introduce a large, luminous, translucent, sphere-like object.

The orb should have:

A mostly transparent or pale frosted-glass body.
A bright white illuminated outline or rim.
Soft internal cloudiness.
Blue reflections.
Strong refraction.
A faint impression of a token suspended inside.
An energetic halo.

The orb advances across the scene and grows rapidly in screen space.

As the orb grows, the earlier token cluster recedes or becomes obscured.

The orb begins to dominate the frame.

Use a carefully directed beam of vivid green-white energy emerging horizontally or diagonally from the left.

Small glowing particles accompany the light.

The beam crosses behind or through the translucent orb, producing bright white bloom and optical refraction.

Add a subtle dark technical grid into the background as the scene changes.

The sphere, light beam, and background should form one coherent transformation.

Avoid an abrupt hard cut if the reference can be matched through a camera-aligned luminous wipe.

Use the motion and brightness of the orb to bridge to the following interface scene.

SCENE 07 — SOL YIELD PERFORMANCE

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 10.20–12.60 SECONDS

Reveal a large dark-blue financial-performance chart inside a rounded rectangular display.

The display should have:

A thick dark frame.
Smooth rounded corners.
Subtle bevels.
Glossy edge reflections.
A slightly dimensional glass surface.
Soft blue illumination.
A dark navy interior.
A clean, restrained line graph.

The entire chart is shown with slight three-dimensional perspective rather than appearing as a perfectly flat screenshot.

Place the graph centrally in the frame, occupying much of the lower and middle sections.

CHART CONTENT:

Two rising trend lines.

Line 1:

Label: INF.
Color: vibrant green.
Starts lower-left.
Continues upward to upper-right.
Includes small upward steps, modest plateaus, and slight local variations.
Ends visibly higher than the comparison line.

Line 2:

Label: JitoSOL.
Color: light gray.
Starts slightly below the green line.
Rises steadily from left to right.
Maintains a lower ending position than the green line.

Place a concise legend in the upper-left corner of the chart.

Do not clutter the chart with unnecessary axes, grid labels, toolbars, buttons, or fake financial statistics.

TEXT ABOVE THE CHART:

"And earning the best yields for your SOL"

Reveal the sentence progressively.

The final line break should visually emphasize the words "SOL" and "yields" through placement and composition.

Use the same white sans-serif typography seen earlier.

Maintain enough spacing between the headline and the chart.

Include tiny white disclaimer copy centered below the chart:

"Yield visuals are for demonstrative and entertainment purposes only.

Past performance is not indicative of future results. Do your own research."

Keep the disclaimer readable at full resolution without allowing it to dominate the composition.

Additional floating INF tokens may appear near the side edges of the scene, connecting the chart visualization to the earlier dimensional token environment.

Lighting should be subdued, clean, and sophisticated.

Avoid excessive bloom on the graph lines.

This is the clearest informational portion of the video and should prioritize legibility.

SCENE 08 — SANCTUM BRANDED OUTRO

TIME: APPROXIMATELY 12.60–16.55 SECONDS

Transition back to the original bright-blue abstract environment.

Reintroduce:

Electric-blue background.
Cyan gradients.
Floating black INF tokens.
Iridescent token faces.
Green geometric sparkle.
Tiny orange and magenta accents.
Large out-of-focus or partially cropped foreground coins.
Gentle ambient parallax.

The transition should quickly restore the optimistic visual identity of the opening.

At the center of the composition, introduce the Sanctum mascot.

The mascot is a clean white, playful, circular stylized face or emblem, with rounded forms and a simple expressive silhouette.

Its shape resolves quickly and smoothly.

Allow a small amount of rotation or morph-like movement as it stabilizes.

Reveal the brand wordmark to the right:

"sanctum"

Use lowercase white lettering with modern rounded sans-serif styling.

Position mascot and wordmark as a horizontally balanced lockup.

The logo should be highly readable and visually prominent.

The surrounding floating tokens and geometric particles continue their gentle drift.

Hold the final brand composition long enough for recognition.

At the end, smoothly darken the image and fade out.

Avoid an abrupt ending, extra CTA, new slogan, or additional unrequested information.

LIGHTING SPECIFICATION

Use a physically coherent studio-lighting setup in all scenes.

BRIGHT WORLD:

Large soft cyan-blue environmental lights.
Smooth background illumination gradients.
Controlled white specular highlights.
Colorful reflected lighting on coins.
Soft ambient fill to retain face detail.
Subtle bloom on bright symbols and sparkles.

DARK WORLD:

Primary overhead cobalt-blue spotlight.
Secondary violet and magenta accents.
Cool rim lights to outline dark token bodies.
Small warmer highlights on orange and gold tokens.
Soft blue reflected floor illumination.
Deep but detailed shadows.

GLASS ORB:

Strong white edge refraction.
Backlighting.
Subtle blue-tinted translucency.
Controlled glowing perimeter.
Environmental reflections.

Avoid unmotivated lighting changes.

Do not let shadows crush small logos or important details.

CAMERA SYSTEM

Use an animated perspective camera.

Primary lens character: moderately wide to normal focal length.

The camera should support:

Slow parallax.
Rapid forward dolly.
Slight roll during transitions.
Perspective scale exaggeration.
Smooth deceleration into hero shots.
Lateral drift.
Controlled focus changes.

Place objects in genuine 3D depth wherever possible.

Foreground objects can be several times larger on screen than distant objects.

Camera animation should be coordinated with object motion rather than added after the scene is complete.

Use shallow depth of field selectively, not continuously.

Typography must generally remain sharp and readable.

EASING AND TIMING

Use a base frame rate of 24 FPS.

Recommended timing principles:

Text reveals: approximately 8–14 frames.
Primary object entrances: approximately 12–20 frames.
Fast transitions: approximately 8–16 frames.
Secondary object stagger: approximately 2–5 frames.
Ambient motion: slow, continuous, low-amplitude.
Hold important phrases long enough for mobile viewing.

Suggested easing starting points:

Soft deceleration: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Strong directional acceleration: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
Fast reveal with smooth landing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

These are starting values only.

Match the actual reference's motion rather than applying uniform easing presets.

MOTION BLUR AND OPTICAL EFFECTS

Use physically appropriate velocity-based motion blur.

Stationary typography should remain crisp.

Fast-moving coins may exhibit strong directional blur.

During the energy-tunnel transition, use richer optical treatment:

Bloom.
Light streaks.
Subtle chromatic dispersion.
Glow.
Perspective blur.
Very slight lens distortion.

Do not overuse lens flares.

Avoid excessive noise, grain, sharpening halos, or synthetic smear.

Preserve clearly readable graphic shapes throughout the animation.

AUDIO DIRECTION

Use the attached video's original soundtrack as the timing and sound-design reference whenever available.

Analyze the soundtrack's rhythmic peaks, transition accents, and synchronized motion events.

If recreating the soundtrack independently:

Use polished futuristic electronic production.
Maintain a light, modern, optimistic overall tone.
Introduce airy whooshes for camera transitions.
Add smooth low-frequency impacts for major scene changes.
Use subtle bright digital accents for token and sparkle movement.
Add a controlled rising sound through the energy tunnel.
Create a restrained shimmer during the orb transition.
Use a concise sonic resolution when the Sanctum logo locks into place.
Avoid overpowering bass, excessive risers, or generic trailer music.

Sound must complement the timing of the imagery.

Do not add narration unless present in the actual reference.

PRODUCTION QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

Maintain perfect visual continuity between all scenes.

Every token must retain consistent shape and materials when seen from different camera angles.

Maintain correct object occlusion.

Avoid intersecting geometry.

Avoid flickering text, distorted logos, temporal inconsistency, disappearing details, and changing materials between frames.

The visual complexity should be concentrated around the hero objects.

Every composition needs intentional negative space.

Use consistent typography and color grading across scenes.

Render all important objects at sufficient resolution to prevent soft edges and aliased details.

The animation should look manually art-directed and precisely keyframed.

Do not make it look like AI stock footage.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

Avoid:

Generic Web3 explainer templates.
Flat 2D cryptocurrency icons.
Oversimplified circular objects.
Random coin rain.
Excessive particle counts.
Arbitrary glitch transitions.
Unmotivated zooming.
Plastic-looking materials without reflection.
Unrealistic coin thickness.
Repetitive synchronized rotation.
Unnecessary interface elements.
A cluttered financial dashboard.
Fake numerical values.
Oversized legal disclaimer text.
Inconsistent typography.
Generic stock background music.
Random scene cuts.
Incorrect token logos.
Garbled captions.
Distorted mascot geometry.
Heavy film grain.
Low-quality bloom.
Constant motion without pauses.
Extraneous slogans or branding.
